{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_dups = data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
dup_count = patient_dups.sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {dup_count}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
invalid_baseline = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {invalid_baseline}')

# Check assay_batch values
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {data["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check arm and severity distribution
print(f'Arm distribution:
{data["arm"].value_counts()}
')
print(f'Severity distribution:
{data["severity"].value_counts()}
')

# Check sample_seq per patient
sample_seq_max = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Patient-level max sample_seq:
{sample_seq_max.describe()}')"}
